title: SKF_CAMPAIGN_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-campaign emits when {headless_mode} is true, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_CAMPAIGN_RESULT_JSON: ': once at the end of a campaign (step 11, after its final state write and the on_complete hook), which the end-of-run health check displays as the run's last line, again as the last line of a headless resume that finds the campaign already complete, and once on stderr at every HARD HALT (status error). The shared emitter, skf-emit-result-envelope.py, builds every line from the payload the step stages (at the end, the context campaign-report.py writes; at a HARD HALT, the one campaign-state.py halt-payload prints), derives exit_code from halt_reason and checks the line against this schema, so the model never types it. This schema is the one definition of the envelope: the skill's references/campaign-contracts.md lists the exit codes and holds the halt command.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries and the exit code of each halt_reason. Campaign writes no result file of its own (its state, report and decision log hold the record). Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when the campaign completed and its report was written. 'error' on any HARD HALT, and on the one degraded finish: a campaign that completed but whose report could not be generated (halt_reason report-failure, exit_code 10, campaign_report_path null), which keeps its state intact.

exit_code.description: The campaign's exit code, derived from halt_reason: null gives 0, invalid-input 2, invalid-state 3, circular-deps 4, invalid-pin 5, inaccessible-repo 6, dependency-deadlock 7, missing-brief 8, corrupt-state 9, report-failure 10, export-cancelled 11, user-cancelled 12, dependency-blocked 13.

halt_reason.description: Null on success. The Exit Codes meaning of the halt otherwise, so a pipeline branches on the failure class without parsing the message; report-failure is the degraded finish described under status.

phase.description: Present on a HARD HALT only: the kebab slug of the step where the campaign stopped, such as 'strategy' or 'skill-loop'.

message.description: The halt message the step displayed, on one line.

error.description: Present on a HARD HALT only: why the campaign stopped. Pipelines branch on halt_reason and read error for the diagnostic.

skills_completed.description: Skills whose status is completed: campaign-report.py's count at the end, campaign-state.py halt-payload's count at a HARD HALT (0 before the state exists).

skills_failed.description: Skills whose status is failed, counted as skills_completed is.

quality_scores.description: Each completed skill's recorded score, by skill name: test-skill's for a Tier A skill, the skill-check score quick-skill records for a Tier B skill. Empty on a HARD HALT.

export_verdicts.description: Each completed skill's quality-gate verdict at Export, by skill name: pass, fallback or fail. Null when the gate could not be applied, and on a HARD HALT.

skills_excluded.description: The completed skills the gate kept from export (verdict fail), so a completed skill is not taken for an exported one. Null when the gate could not be applied, and on a HARD HALT.

campaign_report_path.description: The campaign-report.md step 11 wrote. Null when it could not be written, and on a HARD HALT.

decision_log.description: The append-only _campaign-decision-log.md, whose typed entries record every operator decision, headless default and event. Null before the campaign workspace exists.

duration.description: Wall-clock time from campaign.started_at to its last state write before the report, as campaign-report.py formats it (such as '2h 5m 3s'). Null on a HARD HALT.

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies the emitter raised, one string each, starting with its code. Present only when there is at least one.
